name: AgiBot World
summary: AgiBot World is a large-scale dataset collected on AgiBot's own hardware with dual arms, dexterous hands and whole-body mobility, recorded in purpose-built domestic and retail environments. Unlike aggregated corpora it is uniform in embodiment and rich in long-horizon bimanual tasks, addressing the thin dexterity coverage of most open datasets.
innovation: Industrial-scale collection on a uniform bimanual humanoid platform, with tactile and dexterous-hand data.
Staged realistic environments rather than lab benches.
matters: One of the largest open sources of the bimanual dexterous data the field most lacks.
limits: Tied to one proprietary embodiment, and scripted staging may limit true environmental variety.
lineage: The Open X-Embodiment pooling idea replaced by single-platform industrial-scale collection.
